skill.name: socialdatax-content-research-assistant
skill.description: 面向内容运营、品牌调研和创作者的跨平台社媒内容研究助手。适用于小红书、抖音、快手、Bilibili、知乎、Instagram、X / Twitter、YouTube、TikTok、微博、今日头条、好看视频和视频号的选题策划、竞品观察、趋势判断、评论洞察和创作者资料整理，也支持公众号文章链接详情、内容整理和互动统计，来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Research social trends, content, comments, creator profiles, and WeChat articles with SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most static flags match Markdown notation, social platform identifiers, or readable prose. Confirmed risks include unpinned credential-bearing CLI execution and privileged setup; additional concerns include shell input handling, token sharing, billing links, and undisclosed local writes. No evidence of embedded prompt injection or deliberate credential theft was found in the reviewed text.

remediation.issue: The CLI resolves a mutable npm release for authentication and research.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and verify an exact CLI release before execution. Require approval before first use and expose only the service credential needed by the reviewed process.

remediation.issue: The FFmpeg setup can install host software with elevated privileges.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an existing FFmpeg binary. Require separate user approval for any installation and leave privileged commands to the user.

remediation.issue: Shell examples accept arbitrary share text without isolation rules.
remediation.suggestion: Pass each keyword, URL, identifier, or cursor as a separate argument without shell evaluation. Prefer structured MCP calls when available.

remediation.issue: The stated read-only boundary omits local media downloads and decryption.
remediation.suggestion: Separate media downloads from research. Require explicit approval for the operation and destination, and keep writes within an approved directory.

remediation.issue: The output rules require forwarding and storing complete token-bearing links.
remediation.suggestion: Keep full links only for authorized lookups. Redact token parameters in reports, logs, and exports, or cite a note ID instead.

remediation.issue: The billing workflow prefers links from unverified error text.
remediation.suggestion: Use the fixed SocialDataX billing page instead of forwarding a URL taken from an error.

content.user_title: Research Social Media Content Across Platforms
content.value_statement: Social media research is hard to compare when posts, trends, and comments come from different platforms. Use SocialDataX to collect samples and organize the evidence by platform.
actual_capabilities: Search posts, videos, or articles by keyword on supported platforms.
Retrieve hot lists on supported platforms and report available ranks and popularity signals.
Look up content by a supported link or ID and capture published dates and engagement metrics when available.
Retrieve comments, supported replies, and selected interaction records for analysis.
Look up creator profiles and recent posts, with creator search on selected platforms.
Retrieve WeChat official account article details and available interaction statistics from an article link.
limitations: Research requires a configured SocialDataX credential or an authenticated hosted MCP connection. Some requests consume account credits.
Search filters, date ranges, reply retrieval, and pagination vary by platform.
Search results and comment samples may be incomplete and do not represent all platform activity.
The workflow does not publish or modify social accounts. The separate Hongguo media option writes local files and requires FFmpeg.

use_cases.title: Plan Editorial Topics
use_cases.description: Compare a hot list with keyword search results to choose topics for an editorial calendar.

use_cases.title: Find Themes in Product Feedback
use_cases.description: Review comments on selected product posts and separate recurring problems from isolated feedback.

use_cases.title: Shortlist Creators
use_cases.description: Compare creator profiles and recent posts to find accounts that cover a specific topic.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Hot List
prompt_templates.prompt: Show five topics from the current Douyin hot list. Include rank and any available popularity signal.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Check one platform for topic ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Comments on a Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Review one page of comments on this YouTube video: [link]. Summarize recurring themes without listing commenter names.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Review audience feedback on a known video.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Searches Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu and Douyin for [topic] from the past seven days. Use up to two pages per platform. Separate shared themes from platform-specific findings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare two platforms using a bounded sample.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Creator Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Xiaohongshu and Douyin creator profiles: [profile links]. Use up to five posts per account from the past 30 days. Compare topic fit, show supporting post IDs, and flag missing evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Build a shortlist from profile and post evidence.

output_examples.input: What themes appear in the first page of comments on this YouTube meal prep video?
output: Illustrative sample: 20 visible comments were reviewed.
Recurring theme: Viewers asked how long prepared meals stay fresh.
Other theme: Several viewers requested lower-cost ingredient substitutions.
Scope: These observations describe one page, not the full comment thread.

output_examples.input: Compare a small Xiaohongshu and Douyin sample about small kitchen storage.
output: Illustrative sample: Xiaohongshu posts emphasized cabinet layouts and product comparisons.
Douyin videos in the sample emphasized short before-and-after demonstrations.
Both samples included renter-friendly storage ideas. This does not establish a platform-wide trend.

best_practices: Specify the platform, keyword or link, date range, and maximum sample size.
Start with one page and expand only when you need more evidence.
Keep hot lists, search results, and comments separate. Cite safe links or content IDs and distinguish observations from conclusions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys, authorization headers, or credential files into chat.
Do not treat a hot list or comment sample as evidence about all users.
Do not include token-bearing URLs in reports intended for sharing.

faq.question: Which platforms can I research?
faq.answer: The skill supports platforms including Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Zhihu, Instagram, X, YouTube, TikTok, Weibo, Toutiao, Haokan, and WeChat Channels.

faq.question: What access do I need?
faq.answer: Use an authenticated hosted MCP connection or configure a SocialDataX key for a reviewed CLI. Keep the key out of chat.

faq.question: Can I start from a post or profile link?
faq.answer: Yes, when the platform supports link lookup. Provide the link or the platform-specific ID for the item you want to research.

faq.question: Can I read long comment threads?
faq.answer: Some platforms support pagination and reply retrieval. Set a limit and check whether the results cover the full thread.

faq.question: Can I check a WeChat official account article?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the article link to request article details and any available interaction statistics.

faq.question: Does the skill post or change my social account?
faq.answer: The research tools retrieve data and do not post, like, or comment. A separate Hongguo download workflow can write a local media file.
